一、以太坊当前价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月二日下午，以太坊最新报价为二千二百九十五美元，过去二十四小时上涨约百分之零点七九。从小时线来看，价格在二千二百七十七美元至二千三百零五美元之间波动，整体呈现小幅反弹后企稳的态势。

回顾近五个小时的K线数据，以太坊在十三点时段触及二千二百七十七美元的日内低点后出现买盘介入，价格一度冲高至二千三百零五美元，随后回落至二千二百八十七美元附近。成交量方面，最近一个完整小时录得约三千四百三十万美元的成交额，较前一小时的二千一百八十四万美元明显放大，显示反弹过程中有资金积极参与。

以太坊近期的走势受到多重因素影响。一方面，美国现货以太坊ETF在十月份录得约十六点一亿美元的净流出，创下自二零二四年七月上市以来的最差月度表现。另一方面，链上数据显示验证者退出队列降至接近零，减少了短期内的抛压。此外，代币化股票市值达到八点二七亿美元，同比增长百分之一百七十，为以太坊生态提供了基本面支撑。

二、技术指标解读

从均线系统来看，当前七小时均线约为二千二百九十美元，二十五小时均线约为二千二百八十美元，九十九小时均线约为二千二百六十四美元。短期均线位于中长期均线上方，价格站稳在九十九小时均线之上，中期趋势相对偏多。

MACD指标方面，DIFF线约为五点八六，DEA线约为六点四六，柱状图为负零点六零，空头动能正在减弱。RSI六周期指标快速回升至六十一点二零，十二周期为五十八点九五，二十四周期为五十七点一四，三线均处于中性偏强区域，显示短期反弹动能有所恢复。

布林带方面，上轨约二千三百一十美元，中轨约二千二百八十四美元，下轨约二千二百五十七美元。价格在中轨上方运行，接近上轨位置，短期存在触及上轨后回落的风险。KDJ指标中K值回升至四十一点七八，D值为三十九点九四，J值达到四十五点四四，三线低位金叉后持续上行，短期多头占优。

抛物线SAR指标显示止损位约在二千三百一十三美元，高于当前价格，维持看空信号。综合来看，以太坊技术面相对比特币更为健康，短期反弹结构完整，但需要关注上方二千三百一十美元附近的压力。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场情绪近期呈现分化格局。机构层面，ETF的持续流出反映了部分资金对短期风险的规避态度。但链上数据表明，质押网络的稳定性正在增强，验证者退出意愿极低，说明长期持有者对以太坊的价值依然认可。

值得关注的是，币安黑客事件中约三十二点四亿美元的被盗资产仍以以太坊和比特币形式存在，这部分资金的潜在流动可能对市场价格造成冲击。FBI已向相关节点运营商施压要求冻结涉案资金，THORChain也因事件暂停了互换功能，引发了去中心化与监管合规之间的讨论。

从生态发展角度来看，代币化真实世界资产的持续增长为以太坊提供了新的叙事支撑。随着全球监管机构加速稳定币框架的制定，以太坊作为智能合约平台的地位有望进一步巩固。短期来看，美国中期选举结果将对加密政策走向产生重要影响，市场需要保持耐心等待方向明朗。

热门代币方面，MITO报价零点零零八七零美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之十八点零五；HAEDAL报价零点零二七八三美元，涨幅百分之十四点一五；KORUB报价十一点八九美元，涨幅百分之十点八一。

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep by My Screen—Sharing Them Just as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every lesson, so I wrote these down and stuck them up:

First: Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
Second: Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
Third: Never add to a losing position or average down.
Fourth: After three losing trades in a row, stop trading for the day. Just watch—don’t trade.
Fifth: Withdraw some of your profits. The money goes out; the discipline stays.

There are only five rules, and not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they read the market wrong—it’s that their execution fell apart. Let’s keep each other accountable.

🚀 Binance: The Future of Cryptocurrency Is Bigger Than We Think!

The world of finance is changing rapidly, and cryptocurrency is becoming an important part of the digital economy. At the center of this transformation is Binance, one of the world's most recognized cryptocurrency platforms.

But what makes Binance so interesting? It's not just about buying and selling digital assets. It's about technology, innovation, security, and the future of digital finance.

🌍 The Cryptocurrencies Everyone Is Watching

Let's talk about some of the biggest names in crypto:

🟠 Bitcoin (BTC): Often called digital gold, Bitcoin remains one of the most recognized cryptocurrencies.

🔵 Ethereum (ETH): More than a digital currency, Ethereum supports smart contracts and decentralized applications.

🟡 BNB: Binance's ecosystem token, used across various Binance services and applications.

💵 USDT: A stablecoin designed to follow the value of the US dollar, making it an important part of crypto trading and transfers.

💜 XRP: A cryptocurrency associated with blockchain-based payment solutions.

Each cryptocurrency has a different purpose, technology, and level of risk.

🔥 Why Does Binance Attract So Much Attention?

Binance brings several crypto-related services together in one ecosystem. Users can explore market information, learn about blockchain technology, discover new projects, and access different digital assets.

Another important feature is Binance Academy, where beginners can learn about cryptocurrency, blockchain, and digital security.

📊 The Future: Opportunity Meets Responsibility

The cryptocurrency market never stops evolving. Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB, and other digital currencies continue to attract attention from people interested in blockchain technology.

However, one thing should never be forgotten: crypto prices can rise and fall dramatically. Research, patience, and understanding the risks are more important than following social media hype.

💡 My Final Thoughts

Binance represents more than a cryptocurrency platform. It is part of a much bigger conversation about how technology could transform the future of money.

The real question is not simply which cryptocurrency will become popular next.

The real question is: Are we ready to understand the future of digital finance? 🚀

一、以太坊当前价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月二日下午，以太坊最新报价为二千二百九十五美元，过去二十四小时上涨约百分之零点七九。从小时线来看，价格在二千二百七十七美元至二千三百零五美元之间波动，整体呈现小幅反弹后企稳的态势。

回顾近五个小时的K线数据，以太坊在十三点时段触及二千二百七十七美元的日内低点后出现买盘介入，价格一度冲高至二千三百零五美元，随后回落至二千二百八十七美元附近。成交量方面，最近一个完整小时录得约三千四百三十万美元的成交额，较前一小时的二千一百八十四万美元明显放大，显示反弹过程中有资金积极参与。

以太坊近期的走势受到多重因素影响。一方面，美国现货以太坊ETF在十月份录得约十六点一亿美元的净流出，创下自二零二四年七月上市以来的最差月度表现。另一方面，链上数据显示验证者退出队列降至接近零，减少了短期内的抛压。此外，代币化股票市值达到八点二七亿美元，同比增长百分之一百七十，为以太坊生态提供了基本面支撑。

二、技术指标解读

从均线系统来看，当前七小时均线约为二千二百九十美元，二十五小时均线约为二千二百八十美元，九十九小时均线约为二千二百六十四美元。短期均线位于中长期均线上方，价格站稳在九十九小时均线之上，中期趋势相对偏多。

MACD指标方面，DIFF线约为五点八六，DEA线约为六点四六，柱状图为负零点六零，空头动能正在减弱。RSI六周期指标快速回升至六十一点二零，十二周期为五十八点九五，二十四周期为五十七点一四，三线均处于中性偏强区域，显示短期反弹动能有所恢复。

布林带方面，上轨约二千三百一十美元，中轨约二千二百八十四美元，下轨约二千二百五十七美元。价格在中轨上方运行，接近上轨位置，短期存在触及上轨后回落的风险。KDJ指标中K值回升至四十一点七八，D值为三十九点九四，J值达到四十五点四四，三线低位金叉后持续上行，短期多头占优。

抛物线SAR指标显示止损位约在二千三百一十三美元，高于当前价格，维持看空信号。综合来看，以太坊技术面相对比特币更为健康，短期反弹结构完整，但需要关注上方二千三百一十美元附近的压力。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场情绪近期呈现分化格局。机构层面，ETF的持续流出反映了部分资金对短期风险的规避态度。但链上数据表明，质押网络的稳定性正在增强，验证者退出意愿极低，说明长期持有者对以太坊的价值依然认可。

值得关注的是，币安黑客事件中约三十二点四亿美元的被盗资产仍以以太坊和比特币形式存在，这部分资金的潜在流动可能对市场价格造成冲击。FBI已向相关节点运营商施压要求冻结涉案资金，THORChain也因事件暂停了互换功能，引发了去中心化与监管合规之间的讨论。

从生态发展角度来看，代币化真实世界资产的持续增长为以太坊提供了新的叙事支撑。随着全球监管机构加速稳定币框架的制定，以太坊作为智能合约平台的地位有望进一步巩固。短期来看，美国中期选举结果将对加密政策走向产生重要影响，市场需要保持耐心等待方向明朗。

热门代币方面，MITO报价零点零零八七零美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之十八点零五；HAEDAL报价零点零二七八三美元，涨幅百分之十四点一五；KORUB报价十一点八九美元，涨幅百分之十点八一。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their gains in this market are those who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days in a year means 12x your money; earning a steady 10% a month
means 30x your money over three years. It doesn’t sound thrilling, but there’s something remarkable about it—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities are something you wait for, while discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “doubling your money this week.” Set it as “making no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former is given by the market,
while the ability to achieve the latter is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital are qualified to keep playing.

Crypto Mini-Lesson: Upgradeable Contracts
EIP-1967 specifies standard storage locations for proxy contracts to store the addresses of their logic contracts and administrators, making it easier for block explorers and wallets to recognize proxy contracts.
After an Ethereum contract is deployed, its bytecode itself cannot be modified. Projects that support upgrades generally use the proxy pattern to achieve this.

title: 跌的没破位、涨的没量，这盘在等什么？
subTitle:
跌的没破位、涨的没量，这盘在等什么？

手上还有货的人，这会儿大概在算两笔账。一笔是这两天跌下来没走的浮亏，另一笔是万一这里真是底的踏空。两笔都算不清，因为盘面既没给出该走的理由，也没给出该加的理由。我翻了一遍十个币的读数，能给的最实在的答案是：这个位置，多空都没在用力。

先说跌得最狠的那个。LINK 二十四小时 -1.96%，十个币里垫底，但过去四小时它涨得最多，+0.66%。同一份数据里还有几处对不上：RSI 42.6 是十币最高，布林带位置 25.8% 最高，三十日区间分位 27.0% 也是最高。跌得最多，位置却最高，说明它前面跌得比人家少，现在在补。$LINK 现价 11.368，MA99 在 11.4253，差 0.5%，还没真跌破。二十四小时低点 11.226 也没摸到三十日低点 10.273。ATR 5.81%，波动是十币里最大的两个之一，这种票一根针就能把止损扫掉。

再看量能。ETH 的成交量对七日均量是 0.76，其余九个在 0.05 到 0.56 之间，只有它接近七成。价格上 ETH 二十四小时 +1.15%，十二小时 +0.15%，四小时 +0.10%，三个时间维度都收正。$ETH 现价 2293.15，MA7 在 2290.40，刚站上去 0.1%，MA25 2389.22 还压在头上 4%。RSI 37.5，仍在弱区。量放出来了价格却没走出去，这种组合我读成低位有人在接，但接的人也不急。

大盘这边，BTC 报 78040，二十四小时 +0.12%，看着是红的，拆开就不是了：十二小时 -0.48%，四小时 -0.05%，涨幅是白天留下的，最近这一段没再往前走。二十四小时区间 77602.72 到 78878.01，现价落在 34% 的位置，靠下。MA7 78798.56 在上方压着，MA99 76712.71 在下方 1.7% 托着，中间这段就是它现在的活动范围。ATR 2.45%，十币最低，波动被压得很扁。

站上 MA99 的还有两个。BNB 706.06，二十四小时 -1.27%，MA99 701.91 仍在脚下 0.6%，布林带位置 16.0%。AVAX 8.615，跌 1.92%，第二狠，但 MA99 8.429 也没丢，离它有 2.2%。XRP 1.2591，涨 0.57%，二十四小时区间位置 75%，三个时间维度也都是正的，只是幅度比 ETH 小一截，而且连 MA7 1.2733 都还没收回。原本 LINK 也在这条线上，今天掉下去了，所以站上 MA99 的从四个减到三个。

位置更靠下的几个，问题各不相同。SOL 报 94.56，RSI 29.0 进超卖，布林带位置 5.4%，三十日区间分位 7.4%，三项都是十币最低。它离布林下轨 93.70 只剩 0.9%，三十日低点 92.34 就在脚下。ADA 0.1912，跌 1.19%，离 MA25 有 11.89%，是偏离最远的一个，三十日分位 9.2%，二十四小时低点 0.1897 距布林下轨 0.1846 也不远。DOGE 0.07554，跌 0.30%，RSI 35.4，布林位置 15.1%，没什么动作。TON 要单独提：二十四小时 +0.95%，四小时 -0.99%，是四小时跌得最多的一个，把涨幅吐回去了；量能 0.05，十币最低，几乎没人交易；MACD 柱 +0.003564，十个币里只有它在零轴上方；价格 1.60 还站在 MA7 1.5814 上面。这三个读数凑一起，更像没人管，不像有人砸。

把这十行数字叠起来，二十四小时四个红六个绿，十二小时两个红八个绿，四小时七个红三个绿。中午那段十二小时是今天最差的窗口，四小时这一段全体回来一点，但幅度全在 1% 以内，最大的 LINK 也只有 0.66%。量能对七日均量 0.05 到 0.76，没有一个过八成。价格在四小时上转正、量能没跟上，我倾向读成卖压暂停，不是买盘进场。三十日区间分位十币全落在 9.2% 到 27.0%，都在底部三成以内，往下压和往上冲的空间都不大。

接下来我只盯位置，不讲方向。BTC 若收在 MA99 76712 下方，76325.98 那个三十日低点就要重新测试，站上 MA99 的会从三个继续减。SOL 若破 92.34，超卖就不再算支撑，ADA 和 DOGE 大概率跟着走。反过来，BTC 若收回 MA7 78798 并且量能对七日均量过一倍，这轮横盘才算有点往上的意思；收不回去，就还是 76712 到 78798 之间来回磨。

这份读数取的是北京时间 21:49 的快照，比午间晚了大半天，价格已经换过几轮，看的时候对着实时价再校一遍。仓位怎么摆是你自己的事，别把别人的判断直接当止损位用。

translatedData.content:
Binance withdrawal tally updated: cumulative net outflows of about $4.72 billion, with another roughly $1.08 billion out after day one

This is a belated update: Reuters published these figures at 18:42 this afternoon, but they didn’t make it into the previous rounds, so here’s the missing piece. This isn’t a new wave of withdrawals tonight; it’s the second update to the cumulative tally.

First, let’s reconcile the figures—don’t mix these two up:
Day-one tally (November 1, 14:00–23:30 Beijing time, according to Binance’s official figures): $4.649 billion withdrawn and $1.01 billion deposited, for net outflows of about $3.64 billion, equal to 2.1% of the $171 billion in assets reported in the October 28 proof of reserves.
Cumulative tally (Reuters cited a Binance spokesperson this afternoon; same basis as Bloomberg): since withdrawals reopened on the morning of November 1, cumulative net outflows have reached about $4.72 billion, or roughly 2.8% of platform assets. Subtracting the two figures, about another $1.08 billion flowed out net after the day-one window.

In terms of what it means, this is still “a surge followed by a pullback,” not a second bank run. Binance’s statement on X remains that “after an initial spike, withdrawal volumes have declined and stabilized, while deposits remain substantial.” The Reuters report also offered two points of comparison: in the week after Silicon Valley Bank collapsed in 2023, about $7 billion in Circle’s USDC flowed out; in the 72 hours after FTX collapsed in December 2022, Binance itself saw net outflows of about $6 billion. This time’s $4.72 billion has not reached either of those levels.

A note on methodology is also important: the $4.72 billion figure is the official figure provided by a Binance spokesperson. Don’t mix it with DefiLlama’s wallet-tracking methodology—the post at 18:38 explained that it includes transfers between the exchange’s own wallets. A Binance spokesperson has disputed its accuracy; the two figures are not from the same ledger.

Current prices: $BTC  about $78,064 (24h +0.16%) and $ETH  about $2,296 (24h +1.32%), both checked against two sources at 21:39 tonight. Prices haven’t fallen alongside the outflow figures, suggesting that the market is currently pricing this as “manageable withdrawals,” not as “the platform is in trouble.”

Background for comparison (older figures, not new developments): about $6.3 billion stolen on October 29; withdrawals on 15 chains resumed on November 1, with about 95% restored and the remaining roughly 5% in low-liquidity tokens; fiat withdrawals for five currencies resumed this afternoon (reported at 17:38); the full zero-knowledge proof of reserves remains based on figures from November 3, and no timeline for the second phase has been announced.

Risk note: $4.72 billion is cumulative net outflows according to a spokesperson, not a third-party audit figure. Withdrawals for most tokens have not fully reopened, and fees and limits, as well as the second-phase arrangements, are still pending. Don’t interpret “stabilized” as “fully restored.”

Which side are you on: has this stabilized, or is a second wave still to come?

币安提现账单更新：累计净流出约 47.2 亿美元，首日之后又走了约 10.8 亿

这篇是补发：路透今天下午 18:42 就刊发了这组数，前面几轮没排上，现在把账补齐——它不是今天晚上的新提现潮，而是累计账单的第二次更新。

先对账，两个数别混：
首日账（11 月 1 日 14:00–23:30 北京时间，币安官方口径）：提现 46.49 亿美元、存入 10.1 亿美元，净流出约 36.4 亿美元，占 10 月 28 日储备证明口径 1,710 亿美元资产的 2.1%。
累计账（路透今天下午引币安发言人、彭博同口径）：自 11 月 1 日上午重开以来，累计净流出约 47.2 亿美元，约占平台资产的 2.8%。两数相减，首日窗口之后又净走了约 10.8 亿美元。

定性上这仍是“放量后回落”，不是第二波挤兑：币安在 X 上的说法仍是“起初冲高后，提现量已下降并趋稳、存入量仍可观”；路透稿还给了两个参照——2023 年硅谷银行倒闭后一周，Circle 的 USDC 约走了 70 亿美元；2022 年 12 月 FTX 倒闭后 72 小时，币安自己也走过约 60 亿美元净流出。这次的 47.2 亿还没到那两个量级。

口径提醒也很重要：这 47.2 亿是币安发言人给的官方口径，别跟 DefiLlama 那套钱包追踪口径混着用——那套 18:38 帖里讲过，含交易所自有钱包之间的划转，币安发言人已质疑它不准确，两个数不是同一本账。

现价 $BTC 约 78,064（24h +0.16%）、$ETH 约 2,296（24h +1.32%），都是今晚 21:39 双信源实测。价格没跟着流出数字一起砸，说明市场目前是按“可控的提款”在定价，不是按“平台要出事”在定价。

背景对照（旧数，不作新进展）：10 月 29 日被盗约 63 亿美元；11 月 1 日 15 条链提现恢复、填回约 95%、剩余约 5% 为低流动性币种；今天下午法币 5 币种提现恢复（17:38 已发）；完整零知识储备证明仍为 11 月 3 日口径，第二阶段时间表仍未公布。

风险提示：47.2 亿是发言人口径的累计净流出，不是第三方审计数；大部分代币提现仍未全开，手续费与限额、第二阶段安排都还没兑现，别把“趋稳”读成“全恢复”。

Just two days ago, we mentioned that Michael Saylor’s MicroStrategy had increased its stock purchases. Now it has gone the other way and spent another $65.5 million to buy 811 bitcoins. The underlying reason is MicroStrategy’s long-term bullish stance on Bitcoin and its ability to act on it. The company not only disclosed an increase in its Bitcoin holdings in its financial report, but also demonstrated through its actions how institutional investors are reallocating to digital assets in the wake of FTX. Given that Bitcoin makes up as much as 200% of its holdings, this move is not an isolated event, but a typical example of institutional capital continuing to flow into the crypto market. It means institutional demand for Bitcoin remains strong. This is especially true when sentiment in traditional financial markets is subdued, as digital assets have become a new outlet for capital seeking a safe haven and growth.

Market impact
The immediate effect is a boost to short-term sentiment around BTC, particularly given that MicroStrategy clearly stated during its earnings call that Bitcoin is an important reserve asset. This could encourage some traditional institutional investors to continue allocating to digital assets, but the medium- to long-term trend depends more on Bitcoin’s own fundamentals. In terms of capital flows, this means there is additional buying support for Bitcoin around 77K. However, given the company’s large-scale stock purchases in recent days, it remains to be seen whether it will continue to be a net buyer of Bitcoin or redirect funds back into equities. In similar historical cases, large institutional acquisitions have usually taken place during market pullbacks. This disclosure provides a strong reason for support around 77K–78K for BTC. If Bitcoin holds firm in this range, it could attract more institutional capital. This thesis may only gain further traction if MicroStrategy discloses another net purchase of Bitcoin next quarter.

前两天刚说过这件事，现在有了新进展。Strive最近大手笔买了124枚比特币，一下子让它在机构比特币储备竞赛中追平了Metaplanet。这事儿发生在加密货币钱包管理领域，意味着钱怎么进钱包、怎么存，成了比钱包本身更重要的话题。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Strive此举根本原因不是比特币本身，而是它在抢夺整个加密行业最稀缺的资源——资金存取渠道。以前大家关心谁做钱包，现在更关心谁掌握资金阀门。比特币在这里是个流量密码，就像前两天说的砸钱买股一样，本质是看中Strive这种机构的资金运作能力。

对市场的影响

操作思路

The impact on ETH may be indirect, but ETH’s recent strength suggests that funds are seeking assets with diversified sources of value.

subTitle:
浮亏50%的人在看什么？在看「历史最高价」，心里念叨：回到我的成本，
我就走。注意，这个想法里全是执念，没有逻辑。市场不知道你的成本价，
它只认当下的供需。

扛起单之后，你会自动收集利好、屏蔽利空，这叫确认偏误。你会觉得
「这次不一样」，这五个字，历史上烧掉的钱比任何黑客都多。

解药其实很简单，但很难做到：开仓前就写好「什么情况下这笔单的逻辑
失效」，到点执行，不看心情。把决策从持有中剥离出来，你才能看清
盘面在说什么，而不是你想听什么。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When You're Holding On to a Losing Trade, Your Brain Is Deceiving You
translatedData.subTitle:
What is someone down 50% looking at? “The all-time high,” thinking: If it gets back to my cost basis,
I'll get out. Remember, this thought is all attachment and no logic. The market doesn't know your cost basis,
it only responds to current supply and demand.

Once you've decided to ride out a position, you'll automatically seek out bullish news and block out bearish news. This is called confirmation bias. You'll feel
“This time is different”—those five words have burned more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is simple, but hard to follow: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the rationale for this trade
fails,” then act when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate decision-making from holding the position, and only then can you see

😤 The second it closed at 1.0802, my finger hovered over the confirm button—5.8x volume, a bullish candle. Looked pretty intimidating.

That $BTW 15m candle had absolutely explosive volume.

💀 But one look at the bigger picture brought me back to my senses: the 1h bears are still lurking below the moving-average cluster, and the 4h bulls have already fallen below it. 【The hack has put ETH’s funding picture in the spotlight】

The FBI has confirmed that North Korea was linked to the Binance hack, which involved $6 billion, and has asked the DeFi community to block the associated BTC, ETH, and SOL addresses. Reports say the exchange has resumed withdrawals; there is currently no evidence that AI was involved in the attack. THORChain also paused cross-chain swaps across multiple networks, including ETH, due to a block-reorganization vulnerability. First, separate what’s confirmed from what isn’t—that’s how you avoid being swept up in the emotions.

I’d rather talk about a core ETH concept: ETF fund flows. You can think of them as the “reservoir gates” through which institutional money enters the market. In October, ETH-related ETFs saw monthly net outflows of $1.61 billion, a record, yet ETH was still up 1% over the past 24 hours and down 2.1% over the past 7 days, while the Fear and Greed Index stood at just 37. This shows that price hasn’t followed fund flows completely; the market is waiting for a clearer signal of fresh inflows.

So, who is actually affected? ETF holders feel the pressure of fund flows at the product level. DeFi users face the risks of address tracking, reduced liquidity, and trading disruptions—THORChain’s swap suspension is a concrete example. Does the business logic hold up? Yes. ETF fund flows reflect real demand, while on-chain address tracking is a security measure, but neither can tell you directly where the bottom is.

Remember this: when fear is high, first check whether money is flowing back in. Don’t just focus on a single candlestick.

What do you think is happening with ETH’s funding picture—is it bottoming out, or is the sell-off continuing? Would you like to learn more about ETF fund flows or on-chain tracking?

content:
【黑客事件把ETH的资金面推到台前】

FBI已确认朝鲜方面与Binance遭黑客攻击、涉及60亿美元资金有关，并要求DeFi社区封锁相关BTC、ETH、SOL地址。据报道，交易所已恢复提款；目前没有证据证明AI参与了这次攻击。THORChain也因区块重组漏洞暂停了包含ETH在内的多网络互换。先把已确认和未确认分清，后面才不会被情绪带着走。

我更想讲一个ETH的核心概念：ETF资金流。你可以把它理解成机构资金进入市场的“水库闸门”。10月ETH相关ETF月度净流出16.1亿美元，创下纪录，但ETH近24小时仍涨1%，7日跌2.1%，恐惧贪婪指数只有37。这说明价格没有完全跟着资金流走，市场在等更明确的增量信号。

落到实处，谁会受影响？ETF持有人感受到的是产品层面的资金压力；DeFi用户要承担地址追踪、流动性下降和交易中断的风险，THORChain暂停互换就是具体例子。商业逻辑通不通？通。ETF资金流是真实需求，链上地址追踪则是安全机制，但两者都不能直接替你判断底部。

记住这一点：恐惧时先看资金有没有回来，不要只看一根K线。

translatedData.content:
My observation is that, in this Binance theft, what is really worth tracking is not “how much money the hackers took,” but the different states the funds have been split into: still in linked addresses, frozen, or already mixed. Conflating these three makes it easy to overestimate short-term selling pressure and underestimate the difficulty of recovery.

According to data Elliptic provided to PANews, as of 15:30 Beijing time on November 2, about $3.24 billion in stolen assets remained in related addresses, mainly ETH and BTC; about $2.85 billion had been frozen or seized. Money-laundering activity involved 11 blockchains, around 12,000 wallets, and more than 40,000 transactions in less than four days. As of 14:02 that day, about 28 BTC had passed through 18 CoinJoin mixing rounds. These figures reflect a single analytics firm’s methodology; the materials provided for this article contain no independent verification by other firms.

On this basis, a freeze does not mean recovery, and mixing does not mean cashing out. If frozen assets subsequently enter a return or disposal process, their impact on ETH and BTC liquidity will depend on the timing, method, and counterparties; the materials provided here do not include those details. For now, the portion that has actually been sold on the open market can only be inferred from Elliptic’s assessment that “possibly only a very small amount of funds has been cashed out”—it should not be treated as a confirmed fact.

My observation is that three indicators are more important to watch in the short term: whether balances in linked addresses continue to decline, whether the number of CoinJoin transactions increases, and whether exchanges or law enforcement agencies issue new freeze announcements. If the first two accelerate at the same time while the amount frozen stops growing, that would indicate funds are shifting from “interceptable” to “difficult to trace.” If the amount frozen continues to rise, expectations for recovery should be reassessed. Reliance on a single firm’s methodology is the biggest limitation of this analysis; this article does not constitute investment advice.

我的观察是：这起币安被盗案里，真正值得跟踪的不是“黑客拿走了多少钱”，而是资金被切成了几种不同状态——仍在关联地址、已被冻结、已进入混币。把这三者混为一谈，容易高估短期抛压，也容易低估追回难度。

按Elliptic向PANews提供的数据，截至北京时间11月2日15:30，约32.4亿美元被盗资产仍在相关地址，主要为ETH和BTC；约28.5亿美元已被冻结或扣押。洗钱活动在不到四天内涉及11条区块链、约1.2万个钱包和超过4万笔交易；截至当日14:02，约28枚BTC经过18次CoinJoin混币。这些数字来自单一分析机构口径，本次素材未提供其他机构的独立核对。

据此推断，冻结不等于追回，混币也不等于变现。被冻结资产若后续进入返还或处置程序，其对ETH、BTC流动性的影响取决于时间、方式和对手方，本次素材未提供这些细节。真正进入公开市场抛售的部分，目前只能从Elliptic“可能仅有极少资金被变现”这一机构判断中推测，不能当作已确认事实。

我的观察是，短期更该盯三个指标：关联地址余额是否持续下降、CoinJoin笔数是否放大、以及是否有交易所或执法方发布新的冻结公告。若前两项同时加速而冻结规模不再扩大，说明资金正从“可拦截”转向“难追踪”；若冻结金额继续上升，则追回预期需要重估。单一机构口径是这套判断最大的局限，本文不构成投资建议。

📰 Could AI drug discovery send capital markets into a frenzy? Why is this breakthrough by Mistral Large 4 so significant for BTC/ETH?

French AI company Mistral has released its latest model, Mistral Large 4, which can generate 3D molecular structures from simple instructions and solve problems in quantum chemistry. This marks another step forward for AI applications in fields such as materials science and drug discovery—and breakthroughs like this often prompt markets to reassess AI’s value.

Why does this news matter?
Put simply, this is a landmark moment in AI’s shift from “writing code/drawing pictures” to “doing scientific research.” In the past, processing molecular structures with AI required professional chemists to write complex algorithms. Now, ordinary users can generate 3D molecular models with natural-language prompts. Behind this is a leap in AI’s multimodal understanding: models need to understand not only natural language, but also scientific principles.

What does this mean? It means that over the next few years, AI applications in scientific research could grow exponentially. Global investment in drug discovery is currently around $500 billion. If AI can improve efficiency by 15–20%, it could add trillions of dollars in market value. And what the crypto world values most is the narrative of an “efficiency revolution”—Mistral’s breakthrough provides just the right material for it.

Impact on the market
Let’s look directly at the numbers: global AI investment exceeded $10 billion in Q1 2024, with nearly 30% going to scientific computing. What does this breakthrough by Mistral mean? It means AI’s value could shift entirely from “entertainment tool” to “productivity tool.” For crypto assets, this is an important upgrade to the narrative.

Although the positive impact on BTC and ETH in the short term is likely to be felt mostly in market sentiment, AI-powered scientific computing could generate many new applications over the long term. For example, AI-assisted drug discovery could drive synergies between digital assets and the healthcare sector. Historically, whenever a major technological breakthrough occurs (see the metaverse hype in 2020), markets usually need 2–3 months to digest the positive news. The market is now at a point where it needs a new narrative to provide a boost.

Trading strategy
Mistral’s breakthrough has validated the “AI for scientific research” sector, which is its most direct impact on the crypto market. BTC at $77,948 and ETH at $2,290 have already priced in some of the positive news. If no other major events rock the market over the next month, this breakthrough could support Bitcoin trading sideways in the $75K–$80K range. This outlook is void if Mistral makes a major breakthrough in quantum chemistry going forward—for example, developing an algorithm that can cut drug discovery timelines by 50%.

法国AI公司Mistral发布了最新模型Mistral Large 4，能在简单指令下生成3D分子结构并解决量子化学问题。这标志着AI在材料科学、药物研发等领域的应用又往前推进一步，而这类技术突破往往会引发市场对AI价值重估。

简单说，这是AI从"写代码/画画"进入"搞科研"的标志性事件。过去AI要处理分子结构需要专业化学家编写复杂算法，现在普通用户就能通过自然语言指令生成3D分子模型。这背后是AI多模态理解能力的跃迁——模型不仅要懂自然语言，还要能理解科学原理。

意味着什么？意味着未来几年AI在科研领域的应用场景会呈指数级增长。目前全球药物研发投入约5000亿美元，如果AI能提高15-20%的效率，市场价值可能新增数万亿美元空间。而加密世界最看重的就是"效率革命"叙事，Mistral的突破正好提供了这个素材。

对市场的影响
直接看数据：2024年Q1全球AI投资已超百亿美元，其中近30%流向了科学计算领域。Mistral这个突破意味着什么？意味着AI的价值可能从"娱乐工具"彻底转向"生产工具"。对加密资产而言，这是一个重要的叙事升级。

虽然短期内BTC和ETH受利好影响更多体现在情绪层面，但长期看AI科学计算会催生大量应用场景。比如AI辅助的药物研发会带动数字资产在医疗板块的联动。从历史来看，每当出现重大科技突破时（参考2020年元宇宙概念），市场总需要2-3个月消化这个利好。现在行情正好处于一个需要新叙事刺激的阶段。

操作思路
Mistral的突破对加密市场最直接的影响是验证了"AI赋能科研"这个赛道。当前$77,948的BTC和$2,290的ETH已经部分消化了这个利好。如果未来一个月内没有其他重大事件冲击，这个突破会支撑比特币继续在$75K-$80K区间震荡。而以太坊受影响更大，因为它在Layer1领域一直强调AI+Web3的结合。如果ETH能在$2250这个位置站稳，突破$2400的可能性会增加。

如果Mistral后续能实现量子化学领域的重大突破（比如开发出能缩短药物研发周期50%的算法），这个判断作废。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn't Admitting You're Wrong—It's the Ticket You Buy for Your Next Opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people can't bring themselves to cut their losses because they see a stop-loss as proof that they were wrong, and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you've bought in advance, and that small loss is the premium.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn't who gets it right more often, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The most composed traders I've seen are the quickest to admit when they're wrong. Because they know that whether a trade is right or wrong
doesn't matter; what matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself
This is an entry ticket, not a verdict.

Can an interbank tokenized transaction still be settled on a weekend night? The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) moved the answer one step closer today.

On November 2, the HKMA announced that Project Ensemble’s pilot phase, EnsembleTX, has entered a new stage: participating banks can use “tokenized central bank money” to settle interbank tokenized deposits, with settlement available around the clock, 24/7. The number of participating banks has risen to 12, and the number of industry pioneers to 20.

A few points that directly affect everyday people 👇
🔹 Previously, the pilot mainly ran on Hong Kong dollar RTGS, so it was constrained by traditional clearing hours. This time, tokenized central bank money serves as the “foundation”—with the aim of enabling genuine overnight settlement.
🔹 Authorized dealers have completed secondary-market trial transactions in tokenized Exchange Fund Bills. The HKMA says licensed stablecoins will be included in similar trials next.
🔹 At the same Hong Kong FinTech Week event, HSBC Group CEO revealed that RedCoin, a Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, had reached 50,000 users around 10 days after launch. Since October 23, it has been available for transfers and merchant payments in PayMe. More than 3.3 million PayMe customers can activate a stablecoin wallet. HSBC also said it aims to reach “millions” of users and plans to connect it to use cases such as mobile banking and subscriptions to tokenized money market funds.
🔹 Retail use (spending RedCoin in PayMe) and institutional use (24/7 interbank settlement through Ensemble) are two separate tracks. Don’t conflate them and assume “everyone in the city can already use stablecoins to buy groceries around the clock.”

Put simply, Hong Kong is pushing forward on two fronts at once: “Can interbank transactions be settled overnight?” and “Can licensed Hong Kong dollar stablecoins be used for everyday payments?” Have you used the PayMe stablecoin wallet in Hong Kong, or are you more interested in when interbank settlement will really take off?

A protocol suddenly changes its contract logic. Will it affect the coins users have deposited?
Upgradability lets a project fix vulnerabilities and launch new features. The trade-off is that users must trust whoever holds the upgrade privileges not to make unauthorized changes or lose their private keys.
When an upgrade happens, an account with upgrade privileges changes the proxy contract to point to a new logic contract. The address users interact with stays the same, but the logic being executed changes.
Understanding this won’t make me better overnight, but it can help me avoid a few basic mistakes.
Every potential gain comes with its own risks. First, understand the worst-case scenario.

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Compounding Positions: Fortune at Risk, or a Fast Track to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
The term “compounding positions” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a major trend, then compound a few times
and multiply your money dozens of times. Today, let’s talk about what they don’t tell you.

【What Compounding Positions Involves】Instead of cashing out floating profits, you use them as risk capital for new positions,
It’s like using the market’s money to leverage up. As long as the trend continues, compounding is incredible; once it stops, floating profits
of dozens of points can vanish to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

【The Mathematical Truth】The essence of compounding positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60% each time, the odds of getting it right four times in a row
are only 13%. Those posts you see about doubling your money overnight are backed by 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.
